desc: Reaper demon: dark gray tattered cloak trimmed with red, three stacked layers of red bat wings on each side, holds a large scythe. Glowing red narrow eyes. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big hooded head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px dark outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Hood interior is a solid black void with only two small glowing eyes.
